entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, this place has not changed in[n]the slightest...
It feels nostalgic.[clr 27]
Why are we here again?
Are you going in?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed it does. I haven't come[n]back here since I moved away...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Ah, indeed I am...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I simply needed some time to[n]ready my heart.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* The heart again...[n]It seems it will never cease to[n]be our topic of conversation.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The truth is, despite my best efforts[n]to convey the meaning of the heart, I[n]am no closer to understanding it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such a troublesome roadblock[n]never presented itself to me[n]while I was living here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As you know, I spent most of my[n]young life in this very house.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is why we have come now.[n]I wish to reevaluate myself[n]within its decrepit walls.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By coming to this place, I may[n]be able to rekindle the passion[n]for art I once held.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The passion of an inquiring mind on[n]the hunt for pure beauty... before I[n]learned of Madarame's foul nature.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? It won't open.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No... I surely left it unlocked.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What...? The door has jammed!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... I suppose it was quite[n]an old door to begin with.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It had begun to rust even while[n]I was a pupil here. It seems now[n]it has finally broken.
We should get it fixed.
Let's force it open.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is a nice idea, but I am[n]unfortunately not the owner of the[n]house. I cannot call a locksmith.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wish I could fix it myself...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But I struggle with mechanisms as[n]complex as this. I do not have the[n]steady hand required to mend them.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I doubt you will be able to[n]force your way through here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You must have a steady hand[n]if you wish to fix it.
I need to fix the door...
But I don't think I'll be able to[n]with my current [stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27]...
entries.uk: Але з моїм теперішнім показником[n][stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27] це навряд чи вдасться...

entries.en: I might be able to fix it if my[n][stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27] were [clr 26][stLvLabel 2 4][clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... This is a difficult problem.[n]It seems we have no choice but to[n]retreat for today.
I think I'll be able to fix the door[n]with my current [stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName], you are capable of fixing it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...You never cease to amaze me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us head inside.
